title: A loop Session makes its own Choices, and only work it cannot do stops the loop

statements.says: A loop Session never waits for a person.
Where its ticket leaves more than one way open, a loop Session makes the Choice itself and says so in a line that starts with CHOSE.
Where the ticket asks for a check no Session can run, the Session names a Hand check in a line that starts with HAND CHECK, and the ticket still Lands.
A Session begins its report with a line that starts with BLOCKED only when it cannot do the work: a Denial it cannot get past, or a ticket with nothing left to build.
The driver reads the CHOSE, HAND CHECK and BLOCKED lines and no other words.
A Blocked step stops the loop at once, at the step that says it, with its Denials and with no Nudge.
The driver copies each Choice and each Hand check into the log, and lists them all when the run ends.
A Nudge tells a Session that put a choice to a person to make that Choice itself, within what its step allows.
In Finishing, a fault the Session may not fix is closed and told: no edit is made, the Closing note and a CHOSE line name the fault, and the ticket Lands.
The words that tell a Session to choose are in the driver's prompt and not in a skill.
A ticket can Land with a fault that Finishing saw, or with an acceptance criterion no Session could prove.
The list at the end of the run is where the developer learns of a fault Finishing saw and of a criterion no Session could prove, so a run nobody reads to its end hides them.
The counts the driver keeps say how many steps ended Blocked, how many Choices were made, and what a Nudge got.
The CHOSE, HAND CHECK and BLOCKED lines are the Session's own word, as a review's heading is, and the Suite stays the gate.
A loop Session has nobody to ask, and a loop that waits for an answer waits for ever.
The driver lists the Choices and Hand checks at the end so the developer reads what was chosen and what is theirs to run.
The spec holds the design decisions that matter and the Steering files hold the team's rules, so what is left for a Session to choose is small.
The reviews, the Suite and the drift check judge what a Session chose against the spec.
In the loop's records, Sessions put choices to a person in plain words with a recommendation, and the driver read none of it.
In the loop's records, one build that asked a person passed its check, and nine more steps ran before the loop stopped.
One Nudge said to close a ticket, and so settled a choice against the Session's own recommendation.
A ticket whose app check no Session could run closed with that check named in its Closing note and Landed, and the developer ran the check afterwards; the decision makes that behaviour the rule.
An exact line is a fact the driver can read without judging.
The choosing words live in the driver's prompt because "nobody will answer" is true only in the loop, and a developer who runs a skill by hand can still be asked.
The Plugin's output style tells a Session to offer two options when a person has to decide, the driver's words pull against it, and no run has yet shown which one wins.
Nothing shows that a Session writes each CHOSE, HAND CHECK or BLOCKED line when it should.

Having Blocked cover any block, a choice included, was rejected, because it stops the loop for a person's answer to a question the Session could have settled, and a rerun then builds the ticket again from nothing.

Having the driver look for question words in a last message was rejected, because no last message ended in a question mark and words such as "pick one" also end a report whose work is done, so the match stops good loops and still misses bad ones.
Carrying on to Finishing after a Blocked build was rejected, because the ticket cannot Land and a rerun never reads the Kept work, so the six steps after the build are spent for nothing.
Having a Nudge name Blocked as the answer for a choice was rejected, because it turns a choice into a stop.

Having the Session fix the fault it found in Finishing was rejected, because no Suite runs after Finishing, so that edit would Land unproved, and a known fault that is told is safer than an unknown edit.
Treating a fault found in Finishing as Blocked was rejected, because a rerun builds the ticket again and can make the same fault again, and the loop stops for something a later ticket can mend.

Having the Closing note alone carry Choices and Hand checks was rejected, because it is written only in Finishing, a Choice can be made at any step, and reading every note back is a model's judgement where a copied line is a count.
This adds to the record that says which checks earn a Nudge, by saying what a Nudge tells a Session that asked and naming the one stop a Nudge respects.

The parts that let every Session make a Choice, and that have Finishing tell a fault in a CHOSE line, are superseded by the record that says only a step that builds makes a Choice and a Departure is listed first; the rest stands.
